records.review_label: Cocoa beans, liquor and cocoa-sugar mixtures
records.positive_matrix_proof_required: Confirm whether the final tested food is cocoa powder, cocoa liquor, cake, beans or mixture and document the legally prescribed dry fat-free substance analytical basis.
records.why_reference_must_not_transfer: The official cocoa-powder Lead source uses a dry fat-free basis. Whole beans, cocoa mass/liquor, cocoa cake and mixed cocoa-sugar food are not automatically cocoa powder.
